page.title: Financial reports
page.subtitle: Reports built directly from the general ledger

income.title: Income statement — {{period}}
income.no_entries: No posted entries yet — all values stay zero until real entries are posted

balance.title: Balance sheet — as at {{date}}
balance.unbalanced: ⚠ Assets do not equal liabilities and equity — with double entry this only happens through a line on an account outside the five types; review it with support

cash.title: Cash flow statement — {{period}}
cash.missing_accounts: ⚠ These accounts are missing from the chart of accounts and show as zero: {{accounts}}
cash.retained_closed: Profit closed to retained earnings in the period
cash.deferred_revenue: Change in deferred revenue (collected for service not yet delivered)
cash.customer_prepayments: Change in customer advances and tenant credit
cash.other_operating: Change in other assets and liabilities
cash.not_reconciled: ⚠ Does not match the measured change in cash accounts

branch.title: Performance by branch — {{period}}
branch.hint: Calculated from posted entries in the base currency, so branches trading in another currency appear in one comparable total.

deferred.title: Deferred revenue — an obligation for a period not yet served
deferred.intro: An installment falls due at the start of its period, so what is collected for an unserved period stays a liability and turns into revenue month by month. Outstanding total:
deferred.unlinked_title: Payments that did not pass through deferred revenue

bankdiff.title: Bank differences — ledger balance against shown balance
bankdiff.intro: The ledger balance comes from the general ledger. Manual bank movements are for reconciliation and are not posted, so they do not move the balance — anything they moved before that shows here as a difference.
bankdiff.separated_on: ⚠ Before {{date}}, bank receipts are included in cash — until that date banks had no accounts in the chart.

trial.title: Trial balance
trial.no_movement: No movement in the selected period

property.title: Property portfolio indicators — as of today
property.live_hint: These indicators are live and ignore the period chosen above: occupancy and expiring contracts are counted from today.
property.collected_line: Collected overall {{rate}}% of {{due}} due — {{n}} installments overdue

ledger.pick_hint: Choose an account or a party to show its ledger.
ledger.truncated: ⚠ Showing the first {{n}} lines — narrow the range

aging.unapplied_hint: A payment on account or a credit note without an invoice — reduces the balance with no age to belong to
aging.no_rows: No receivables due as of this date
aging.rent_title: Rent installments due and not collected
aging.no_rent_rows: No rent installments due and uncollected as of this date
aging.manual_entries: Manual entries on the receivables account (1200) with no matching document — the report reads invoices and vouchers, while the ledger includes every entry, manual ones too.
aging.account_missing: (The receivables account 1200 is not in the chart of accounts yet.)

gaps.title: Taken numbers not used
gaps.intro: A number taken for a document that is then not completed (a locked period, a rejection, or an interruption) stays taken and is not reused, so it shows here with its name and the time it was taken. The record starts from the first number logged in each series; anything before that was issued before this report existed.
gaps.none_taken: No number has been taken since logging started.
